nodes.notes: File scan over 511 files, 335001 LOC. Pure deterministic discovery.
Subsystem selection: 25 files, 40 internal deps, 14 external boundaries.
Extract 11 modules, 210 procedures, 185 entities. Deterministic parsing.
3 parallel RAG queries over Qdrant. OPT-5: parallel execution reduces wall from ~2.9s to 0.97s.
Transformation planning: 195 target components. Single reasoning call.
Maven clean package -B -q -T 1C. OPT-4: parallel compiler flags.
6 LLM calls (3 M1 + 3 HP) generating design notes. OPT-1: runs concurrently with build. OPT-2: warm-preloaded models. OPT-3: keep-alive calls.
9 behavioral tests, all PASSED. Deterministic HTTP verification.
2 repair cycles: diagnosis (RAG+LLM) + repair (LLM) + verify (deterministic). Bad repair rejected.

serialized_work.reason: Must scan all files before selection
Must extract before RAG queries make sense

critical_path_analysis.parallel_efficiency: 68% (ideal would be 100% but LLM generation has fixed per-call latency)
critical_path_analysis.biggest_serial_bottleneck: inference_batch (68.3s wall for 6 LLM calls = ~11.4s per call average)
critical_path_analysis.second_bottleneck: repair (12s - 2 repair cycles with RAG + LLM diagnosis + repair generation)
critical_path_analysis.third_bottleneck: build_1 (5.9s - Maven compilation, optimized but still sequential)

optimization_impact_on_critical_path.OPT-1_build_inference_overlap: Saves 5.9s by running build concurrently with inference. Build is NOT on critical path after this optimization - it becomes parallel slack.
optimization_impact_on_critical_path.OPT-2_warm_preload: Eliminates cold-TTFT on first inference call. Saves ~15-18s on HP cold arrivals. Models are ready when inference_batch starts.
optimization_impact_on_critical_path.OPT-3_keep_alive_calls: Reduces per-call TTFT from ~17s to ~1s for subsequent calls. Critical for inference_batch parallelism.
optimization_impact_on_critical_path.OPT-4_maven_flags: Reduces build from ~9s to ~6s. Minor impact since build is parallel slack.
optimization_impact_on_critical_path.OPT-5_parallel_RAG: Reduces RAG from ~2.9s to ~0.97s. Minor impact - RAG is small fraction of wall.

conclusion: The critical path is dominated by LLM inference (68.3s of 93.1s critical path = 73%). The only way to significantly improve end-to-end throughput is to reduce inference time per call or reduce the number of inference calls. All deterministic stages (discovery, closure, semantics, build, verification) total <10s and are not the bottleneck. Repair (12s) is the second bottleneck but is necessary for correctness. The optimization strategy is correct: focus on inference efficiency (warm preload, keep-alive, distributed concurrency) rather than deterministic stage optimization.
